packageRules.description: dist/js inlines the color library (and through it color-convert and color-string), so color is a devDependency here but it IS shipped code: a bump changes what consumers execute. Renovate types devDependency bumps chore(deps), which release-please hides and never releases; type this one build(deps) instead - a visible, releasing section - so a bump of bundled code always reaches a published version. The other devDependencies (esbuild, sass, jsdom, jquery for tests, commitlint) stay chore.
